reasoning: 驗證目標：SAT 模式叫用 Browse Genre 時列出全部 SAT Genres。為什麼這樣切：判準是清單的完整性——可收電台所涵蓋的每個 genre 都在清單中；只列出常見數個的實作應失敗，故以現行可收電台的 genre 集合逐一比對。與 112 的差別：該 leaf 驗選取某 genre 之後的頻道清單與調諧，本 leaf 止於 genre 清單本身（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Browse Genre lists all SAT genres
tcs.test_item: When the Browse Genre function is invoked in SAT mode, the HU shall list all SAT Genres
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The genres represented among the receivable Satellite Audio stations are known from an independent source
5. More than one genre is represented
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Invoke the Browse Genre function in SAT mode
2. Scroll through the whole list and record every genre shown
3. Compare the recorded genres against the known genres
tcs.expected_result:
1. A list of genres is displayed
2. The list scrolls to its end
3. Every known genre appears in the list
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
